content.short: Entendre Finance provides an AI accounting and bookkeeping platform to automate blockchain and digital asset activity.
content.description: Entendre Finance provides an AI-powered platform for crypto accounting designed for Web3 teams. It delivers streamlined reconciliation, automated data entry from any exchange or wallet, thorough auditing, and real-time financial reporting. The solution integrates with existing crypto finance stacks and common accounting systems, enabling seamless consolidation of digital-asset finances across their operations. This platform is designed for Web3 teams seeking accurate accounting and seamless data consolidation.
